roadmap.title: Opening hours
roadmap.description: Beat the first zones, click, level heroes, buy hero upgrades and make your first Ascension.

roadmap.title: First days: Centurion bosses and your first Transcendence
roadmap.description: Defeat the Bounty bosses, climb past zone 1,000, finish the 5 and 25 quest tiers and transcend for the first time.

roadmap.title: Mid game: deeper zones, bigger quest tiers and Ancient Souls
roadmap.description: Climb zones 1,200 to about 3,200, finish the 100 quest tiers, and collect your first Ancient Souls.

roadmap.title: Late game: top zones and larger totals
roadmap.description: Push the last pre-Transcendence zones and the first Transcendent zones, and finish the larger kill and hero-level totals.

roadmap.title: Long grind: very large counters
roadmap.description: Finish the 25-burial and 25-revive goals, the high mercenary levels and the deepest Transcendent zones.

roadmap.title: Marathon goals
roadmap.description: Complete the longest goals: 100 burials or revives, 100,000 bosses and burying Leeroy Jenkins.

achievements.summary: Bury the Mercenary named Leeroy Jenkins.

guide.context: The Mercenaries tab opens after you reach zone 139 or ascend for the first time.

steps.text: Recruit Mercenaries until one is named Leeroy Jenkins; names are random.
steps.note: Dismiss unwanted Mercenaries to free slots at 5, but do not dismiss Leeroy Jenkins.

steps.text: Wait for Leeroy Jenkins to die, then bury him instead of reviving him.

guide.context: Transcending resets your Ancients, Hero Souls, Relics and zone progress in exchange for Ancient Souls; Achievements, Rubies, Outsiders and Mercenaries are kept.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Woodchip, the Rodent} at Zone 300 to make Transcendence available.
Click Transcend and confirm the warning.
